topic: Choose a new coffee machine for the shared kitchen

scenario.topic: Choose a new coffee machine for the shared kitchen
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to you when picking a new coffee machine for our shared kitchen—speed, taste quality, ease of cleaning, or upfront cost?

options.name: Breville Barista Express Espresso Machine
options.upside: Offers high-quality espresso with built-in grinder and customizable grind settings for fresh coffee.
options.tradeoff: Requires some skill and time to operate and clean properly, which may slow down busy mornings.
options.concern: Maintenance and cleaning can be time-consuming and may deter less experienced users.
options.best_for: those prioritizing coffee quality and customization over convenience.

options.name: Keurig K-Elite Single Serve Coffee Maker
options.upside: Very fast and easy to use with minimal cleanup, great for quick single cups.
options.tradeoff: Limited to K-Cup pods which can be more expensive and less environmentally friendly.
options.concern: Coffee quality is generally lower than freshly ground options and flavor variety depends on pods.
options.best_for: those valuing speed and convenience above all else.

options.name: Technivorm Moccamaster 79312 Coffee Brewer
options.upside: Brews full pots of high-quality drip coffee with excellent temperature control and durability.
options.tradeoff: Not suitable for espresso or single servings; slower brew time and requires paper filters.
options.concern: Less flexible for individual preferences and takes longer to brew compared to single-serve machines.
options.best_for: those who want consistent, high-quality drip coffee for multiple people.

options.name: Nespresso VertuoPlus Coffee and Espresso Maker
options.upside: Fast and easy espresso and coffee with rich crema, using convenient capsules.
options.tradeoff: Capsules are proprietary and more expensive than ground coffee, with limited flavor control.
options.concern: Environmental impact of capsules and ongoing cost of buying them.
options.best_for: those wanting quick espresso-style drinks with minimal effort.

shared_context: The group consists of exactly 5 coworkers sharing the kitchen at a mid-sized office.
The budget for the new coffee machine is capped at $700.
The machine will be used daily by all 5 members, with varying preferences for coffee style.

personas.name: Tala
personas.background: Tala often grabs a quick cup between meetings and values speed and ease above all else.
personas.private_goal: To ensure the coffee machine is fast and easy to use with minimal cleanup for busy mornings.

personas.name: Thea
personas.background: Thea enjoys crafting high-quality espresso drinks and appreciates machines with customization options.
personas.private_goal: To select a machine that offers excellent coffee quality and allows for grind customization.

personas.name: Vera
personas.background: Vera likes quick espresso-style drinks but also values convenience and ease of use.
personas.private_goal: To have a machine that produces fast espresso-style coffee with minimal effort.

personas.name: Olga
personas.background: Olga prefers reliable, consistent drip coffee for multiple people and dislikes complicated machines.
personas.private_goal: To have a durable, easy-to-use drip coffee brewer that serves several people at once.

personas.name: Isla
personas.background: Isla enjoys sharing coffee with colleagues and values consistent, high-quality drip coffee for the group.
personas.private_goal: To choose a coffee machine that reliably brews excellent drip coffee for multiple users.
